newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BIB continues to dominate Bahrain stocks.
newsitem.headline: BIB continues to dominate Bahrain stocks.

text.p: Bahrain International Bank (BIB) shares continued to dominate active trade on the Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) on Sunday.
BSE figures showed that more than 8.2 million BIB shares changed hands on Sunday, the first trading day this week. The stock closed at 163 fils, up 18 fils from Thursday.

Brokers said speculation on both the Bahraini and Kuwaiti stock markets, a price correction and an improvement in Bahrain's economic situation were the main reasons for the lively trade in BIB shares.
"Share prices have been very low in the past few weeks. Now the market is witnessing a price correction," one broker said.

"Speculation in Kuwait on BIB shares sparked brisk trade on the bank's shares in Bahrain. Investors buy BIB shares either in anticipation of higher prices or to sell them in the Kuwaiti market," he added.
More than 46 million BIB shares were traded on the Kuwaiti Stock Exchange on Sunday. The stock's price climbed to 134 Kuwaiti fils from 128 fils on Saturday.
BSE said the official index reached a new record high of 1,477.23 points, up 22.37 points from Thursday. The bourse is closed on Friday and Saturday.
More than 9.7 million shares worth 1.8 million dinars ($4.8 million) were traded on Sunday in 75 transactions.
